links.outcome: Errors (omissions, inaccuracies, hallucinations) and potential harm in unedited AI-drafted hospital course summaries
links.effect: Feedback on 100 summaries noted omissions (25%), inaccuracies (20%), hallucinations (2%). 88% of unedited summaries had no harm potential, 1% likely moderate harm, no severe harm reported.
links.quote: Feedback on 100 summaries (40.2%) noted omissions (25%) and inaccuracies (20%) but rare hallucinations (2%).

unlisted_practices: Nightly agentic LLM drafting of hospital course summaries emailed to physicians for optional use
Measuring clinician burnout, cognitive load (NASA-TLX), and EHR-logged documentation time before and after AI summarization deployment

screen.reason: Prospective clinical deployment pilot of an agentic LLM (MedAgentBrief) for hospital course summarization, evaluating clinician burden, adoption, and safety (potential for harm).
